claim: The Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and former allies the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have been fighting since April 2023.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] OCHA flash update (16 Apr 2023): clashes between the SAF and the RSF erupted in Khartoum on 15 April 2023. CFR's conflict tracker: the SAF (Burhan) and RSF (Hemedti) jointly carried out the 2019 coup, and Hemedti was Burhan's deputy on the Sovereignty Council - hence 'former allies'.
